description:
Iam a passionate and enthusiastic student interested in AI,electronics,and space technology. I aim to learn, innovate and develop creative solutions through my project.

My project focuses on an AI - based butterfly simulation integrated with an AI chip,wireless transmitter and receiver ,battery and motor system. My aim is to explore AI and wireless technology through innovative design and simulation.
summary: Our project, AI Butterfly Simulation, focuses on combining Artificial Intelligence and wireless technology. It uses an AI chip, transmitter and receiver, battery, and motor system to demonstrate intelligent control and wireless communication. The project aims to explore how AI and electronic components can work together to create an innovative system. Through simulation, we demonstrate the working process and connection between these components. This project helps us understand AI applications, circuit design, and modern technology.
details: Our project combines AI ,wireless, Communication,electronics systems .The AI chip processes signal while the transmitter and the receiver enable wireless communication. The battery powers the motor system.This project demonstrates the use of smart systems technology through simulation
